events.title: Ship classes
events.summary: The player fleet is taking shape around different roles. The current roster includes the Corvette, Assault Frigate, Destroyer, Heavy Cruiser and Battlecruiser. Each brings a different arrangement of weapons, role bonuses, cargo space and handling, giving you reasons to choose a hull beyond its size.The Corvette is the light escort option: a compact ship with fewer weapon mounts and a smaller hold. events.title: Exploration Gameplay
events.summary: Exploration begins with uncertainty. For the most part, if you are friendly with the region’s inhabitants and have not angered them, and you remain in the inner system, you have support. Whether that’s combat, repairs, towing, you have support. But beyond the inner system, navigation becomes blurred and hazardous. events.title: Simulation and Economy
events.summary: Our game’s simulation gives ships somewhere to go and cargo a reason to keep moving. The Galaxy Simulation System, or GSS, tracks this activity beyond your current system. The Faction Economy and Logistics (FELS) System extends it with production, logistics and asset replacement pressure.Below are some debugging info screens to help keep track of this simulation.Faction miners supply refineries and that refined stock feeds industry while haulers connect production and supply hubs.
